The ROM level-map decoder's attribute derivation does not match streamed truth for some metatiles - margins can show wrong-palette art.

issues.summary: At level entry (~frame 7488) an OAM sprite drops its X high bit: (317,158) -> (69,158) with the low byte continuous - right-margin art teleporting to the left. issues.expected: Sprites keep the 9-bit X across the entry transition; zero wrap_suspects in the sweep.
